diagnostics.message: aws_cloudfront_distribution.default explicitly depends_on aws_s3_bucket.origin, but it already has an implicit dependency on that bucket: its origin.domain_name is derived from local.bucket_domain_name, and local.bucket is built from aws_s3_bucket.origin.*.id (also indirectly through data.aws_s3_bucket.selected). The explicit depends_on is therefore redundant.
